name: Parser and serialization robustness
pre_registered_hypothesis: Improving constrained output / parser recovery increases benchmark performance without an entropy policy.
primary_metric: parse failure rate on gated prereq steps

name: Parser and serialization robustness
result_summary: 0/3276 gated primary steps raised or mis-parsed; all 1910 orphans are deliberate free-text no-calls (signature no_call). Parse failure rate ~0%: no headroom.

name: Selective write-rescue on no-call steps (refinement of #10 delayed commitment: same write/no-write commitment margin, opposite direction, per Stage 3 T2 evidence)
mechanism: 58% of gated prereq steps produce no write; exploration samples predict the choice at AUC 0.998; when the primary declines but sampled actions contain a modal write, committing it may rescue facts that never reach the store (the known score bottleneck).
pre_registered_hypothesis: Committing the modal sampled write on no-call prereq steps increases the number of questions whose gold facts are carried+retrievable in the final store, and downstream accuracy vs equal-budget random-select control.
primary_metric: offline: questions with uncarried gold rescued by modal orphan write; live: paired accuracy vs A1
development_data: gov_logs/hnav_shadow orphan records + final snapshots + gold index
decision: GO criterion: expected dAcc >= 0.02 x p_hat-adjusted on >=1 backend from modal-write rescue

name: Selective write-rescue on no-call steps
result_summary: Falsifier GO: modal sampled write rescues gold uncarried by final store: vector 9/9/9 questions (expected dAcc ~+0.035), kv 2/4/4 (+0.013-0.016). A2 fires on only 55/1910 no-call steps (2.9%) -- surgical, low pollution risk. Caveats: pseudo-replicated shadow draws; p_hat conversion optimistic (retrievability unchecked); live trajectories will diverge after committed writes.

next_action: live campaign, primary contrast a2_majority vs a1_random (paired, Holm), secondary vs baseline

name: Factorized operation/target/content uncertainty
pre_registered_hypothesis: Factorized uncertainty (H_op, H_target|op, H_args) predicts action failure better than a single entropy score.

name: Factorized operation/target/content uncertainty
result_summary: Falsified by the pre-registered Stage 3 ladder itself: per-resolution entropies (M5 op / M6 target / M7 full / M8 all) each add ~0 or negative dAUC over vote controls on T1 (dAUC_M8_vs_M4 = -0.013, CI [-0.037, +0.001]); univariate perm p 0.61-0.70, Holm 1.0. On T2 entropy adds +0.0000 beyond votes at any resolution. No factorization signal exists to exploit on this benchmark.
decision: dead: tested by pre-registered ladder, no incremental value at any resolution

name: Backend-specific uncertainty policies
pre_registered_hypothesis: Backend-specific calibration improves over a shared global policy.

name: Backend-specific uncertainty policies
result_summary: No global uncertainty signal exists to specialize: T1 harmful class has 9 positives total (2-7 per backend -- unfittable); T2 vote signal is at ceiling (AUC 0.998) globally, leaving no backend-specific headroom for the prediction task. Backend differences that DO matter (vector rescues 9 questions vs kv 4 in the write-rescue falsifier) are carried forward inside alt10, not as a separate policy family.
decision: dead: nothing to specialize; backend heterogeneity subsumed into alt10 analysis

name: Deterministic write scaffold on no-write prereq turns (REPLACES pre-specified #5 adaptive sampling budget)
mechanism: Loss decomposition on the shadow campaign: ~80% of questions have gold absent from the final store; ~88% of those facts were stated verbatim in the prereq conversation. The dominant loss is CAPTURE failure. Policy: when a prereq user turn produces no resolved write, the middleware archives the user turn text itself (MemGPT-style auto-archiving) -- runtime information only, no gold, no future turns.
pre_registered_hypothesis: Auto-archiving no-write prereq turns raises the fraction of questions whose gold is carried AND retrievable, and downstream accuracy, vs an unmodified baseline.
primary_metric: paired accuracy vs baseline on matched questions (McNemar + bootstrap, Holm)
controls: random-text scaffold of equal volume (content-value control)
negative_controls: scramble scaffold text across scenarios (must destroy the gain)
result_summary: Falsifier GO under REAL capacity limits (50 archival entries, 2000 chars, BM25-visible slug keys): answerability kv 11.8%->30.8% (+18.9pp), vector 18.7%->60.7% (+41.9pp); expected dAcc +0.077 kv / +0.171 vector at p_hat=0.409. Bar was 0.02.
decision: promote to live campaign after the alt10 campaign completes
next_action: implement QwenScaffoldHandler (-FC-SCAF), tests, then 3-rep live A/B

name: Deterministic write scaffold on no-write prereq turns
result_summary: Handler implemented (-FC-SCAF) and live-smoked: 16/16 backend writes accepted, 0 errors, 0 key collisions, content-derived BM25-visible keys, once-per-turn, capacity-capped. Campaign pre-registered (gov_logs/hnav_scaffold/PREREGISTRATION.md) with a shuffled-content control arm.
next_action: launch 3-rep campaign (baseline / scaffold / scaffold_shuffled) after the alt10 campaign finishes

name: Selective write-rescue on no-call steps
primary_metric: paired accuracy a2_majority vs a1_random (equal-budget control), per backend
primary_test: exact McNemar on survival-conditional matched pairs + cluster bootstrap over (replicate,scenario), Holm m=2 over {kv,vector}
negative_controls: shuffled sample-to-step assignment (RUN 2026-08-08: did NOT cleanly collapse; ~70% of vector rescue survives -> non-content-specific carriage)
result_summary: PRIMARY (a2 vs a1): kv +0.0000, vector +0.0138, both Holm p=1.0 -> null. SECONDARY (a2 vs baseline): vector +0.0345 CI[-0.011,+0.079] McNemar p=0.184 Holm 0.736, direction positive 3/3 replicates, reproducing the falsifier prediction (+0.035) exactly but underpowered at n=290 pairs. a1 itself gains +0.021/+0.024 over baseline -> most of the gain is generic extra sampling. Strata moved in predicted direction (vector not_carried 347->333, carried_retrievable 112->124); kv rescues land in carried_NOT_retrievable (19->43). NC did not collapse.
decision: inconclusive-underpowered; fails 8.1 conditions 3 and 7; label frozen, will not be revised
next_action: none; capture channel superseded by RAG program (tier-conditional analysis)

name: Deterministic write scaffold on no-write prereq turns
result_summary: AMENDMENT before launch: tier-conditional re-analysis shows P_HAT=0.409 is tier-blind; scaffold writes land in archival, whose conversion is 0.000 (vector, 0/74) / 0.017 (kv, 1/60) because the agent never reads archival at question time (1/155 entries). Corrected standalone prediction ~0 on both backends. Campaign NOT launched standalone; capture folded into RAG program as pack+read interaction arm. Artifacts: gov_logs/hnav_autonomous/tier_conditional_factors.json, tier_conditional_pooled.json; PREREGISTRATION.md AMENDMENT 1.
primary_test: corrected offline conversion: danswerable x (p_archival - p_not_carried)
decision: do not launch standalone; supersede via pack+read in RAG program
next_action: C1 READ campaign measures the read-conversion factor c; C2 tests capture x read
